skill.name: softsync-records
skill.description: Manage SoftSync workspace records through connected tools, including search, creation, updates, duplicate review, deletion, restoration, and analytics.
skill.summary: Find and maintain linked workspace records, review duplicates, and prepare analytics datasets using SoftSync tools.
skill.author: softsync-lab

security_audit.summary: All 35 static findings are false positives involving Markdown tool names, ordinary CRM guidance, and a sample LinkedIn URL. No evidence found of shell execution, credential theft, or audit-directed prompt injection. One semantic finding identifies unsafe identity matching that can update an unrelated record when identifiers are shared.

remediation.issue: Deduplication treats any exact identifier match as sufficient proof of identity, including potentially shared domains and phone numbers.
remediation.suggestion: Require entity-specific identifiers or corroborating evidence before updates. When identifiers are shared or candidates conflict, show the candidates and obtain user confirmation.

semantic_findings.title: Shared identifiers can trigger updates to unrelated records
semantic_findings.description: The instruction "An exact-anchor hit IS the entity. Update it." follows an OR search including websites, domains, and phones. These identifiers can be shared, so one match can redirect a requested creation into an update of another entity.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The explicit rule makes any matching anchor decisive without requiring uniqueness or resolving conflicting candidates. Shared identifiers make unintended updates plausible despite earlier identity-confidence guidance.

content.value_statement: Managing linked contacts, companies, deals, and tasks requires consistent searches and careful updates. This skill guides connected SoftSync tools through record maintenance and analytics workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides exact, semantic, saved-view, and related-record searches using workspace schema names.
Guides record creation and updates with duplicate checks, structured fields, and links between related records.
Supports enrichment workflows through available tools, including fill-only saves and confirmed overwrites.
Guides duplicate review, irreversible merges, deletion to the Bin, and restoration within 30 days.
Selects tools for counts, sums, averages, grouped metrics, chart datasets, and pipeline forecasts.
Guides activity lookups, permitted status transitions, required comments, and record timers.
limitations: Requires connected SoftSync tools and workspace access; the skill provides instructions rather than a standalone service.
Available operations depend on the runtime tool schema and supported enrichment providers.
Analytics tools return datasets rather than chart images; merges cannot be undone, and Bin restoration is limited to 30 days.
Automatic identity matching can confuse entities with shared identifiers; review ambiguous candidates before updates.

prompt_templates.title: Find a company
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [company name] in my SoftSync workspace and summarize the matching records. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Create a linked contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Add [contact name] with [email] at [company]. Check duplicates first and show ambiguous matches before making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: record creation and relation linking.

prompt_templates.title: Review duplicate contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find likely duplicate contacts in [table]. Show identity evidence and a proposed merge plan. Wait for my confirmation before merging.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze pipeline changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare pipeline value by stage for [current period] and [previous period]. Use supported analytics tools and report missing fields or unsupported comparisons.

best_practices: Inspect the workspace schema and reuse verified record IDs before selecting fields or linking records.
Check multiple identity signals and resolve shared or conflicting identifiers before updating an existing entity.
Review affected records and confirm bulk updates, merges, and deletes before execution.
anti_patterns: Treating shared domains or phone numbers as conclusive proof that two records represent the same entity.
Using guessed record IDs, invented select options, or unsupported tool parameters.
Replacing unsupported bulk operations with unbounded sequences of individual writes.

faq.question: Does this skill work without SoftSync tools?
faq.answer: No. It guides connected SoftSync tools and requires access to the relevant workspace.

faq.question: Which record types can it manage?
faq.answer: It covers companies, contacts, deals, tasks, and custom workspace tables supported by the available tools.

faq.question: How does it check for duplicates?
faq.answer: It searches exact identifiers before semantic name matching. Shared identifiers can create false matches, so ambiguous candidates require review.

faq.question: Can a merge be undone?
faq.answer: No. The service chooses the surviving record, and merges are irreversible. Review candidates and confirm before merging.

faq.question: Can deleted records be restored?
faq.answer: The documented delete action moves records to the Bin. Restoration is available within 30 days.

faq.question: Does it generate chart images?
faq.answer: Analytics tools return datasets, not images. Available dashboard tools can add a chart to a group Reports page.
